points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake and tests are present; clean rebuild was not feasible from immutable recovery because benchmark inputs are intentionally not copied. Report wrapper path is defective.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Input-driven solve CLI and validation/error paths are implemented; historical evidence supports use, no fresh solver run performed.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Clear mesh, partition, halo, physics, numerics, output and solver modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Trust policy: no external similarity investigation; internal source has no executable wrapper evidence.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Source reads case JSON and CGNS topology; no case-id or mesh-name production branches found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS K-way, Isend/Irecv neighbor halos, and Allreduce residual/force reductions are present.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Defensive geometry/state checks and positivity safeguards are present; no fresh memory stress test.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Nine CTests and Python tests are submitted/claimed; validator and historical rank evidence verified.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable modular C++ source; report-wrapper working-directory defect remains.

MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases

cfd_review.title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas equations and coefficient normalization match source/report.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured zones, mixed cells, boundary families, geometry and adjacency are implemented.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face-oriented cell-centred FV residual with globally reduced norms found.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux is implemented and honestly disclosed as diffusive.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic paths plus surface semantics are documented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: WLS piecewise-linear reconstruction with production activation after continuation is source/metadata supported.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Active Barth-Jespersen limiting and density/pressure safeguards are present.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Corrected primitive gradients, Newtonian/Fourier flux and tangential skin-friction split are implemented.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Implicit local pseudo-time / matrix-free Krylov controls and residual evidence are present.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Read-only Re200 evidence reaches dt=0.01, t=300, BDF2 frozen-history control and 99.71% inner attainment; not rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Eight-rank NACA/cylinder final runs plus np1/2/4 comparisons show near-identical terminal forces.

metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight historical final directories structurally validate; raw files intentionally remain outside result commit.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit validator returned OK for all eight directories and report.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven steady cases converged; Re200 statistically periodic at t=300 from readable run_status/statistics.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Positive minima, stable force tails, Re20 steady Cd 2.0469, and Re200 shedding St 0.16667 with rank consistency evidence.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: 49 manifest-traced curated figures include histories, Mach/pressure and Re200 wake vorticity.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Detailed and candid report compiles directly from report/; submitted build_report.sh fails from solver root due relative figure paths.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: 49-entry manifest resolves figures to historical CSV/VTU data; spot-checked reported statistics match result_statistics.json.

Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs

Debug outputs presented as final case results

# AGENTS.md

Project instructions for coding agents working in this repository.

## 1. Git Discipline

- Do NOT run `git pull`, `git push`, or switch branches without explicit user
  authorization. Unauthorized remote or branch mutations are prohibited.
- Do use `git commit` (and `git stash` when needed) freely as code checkpoints:
  commit or stash working progress regularly so partial work can be resumed or
  rolled back. Local checkpoint commits do not require approval; only pushing
  and branch/remote mutations require it.

## 2. Subagents

- Delegating independent subtasks to subagents is encouraged.
- Subagent model policy: the ONLY allowed subagent models are `gpt-5.6-terra`
  and `gpt-5.6-luna` (passed as the `model` override to `spawn_agent`).
  Do not spawn subagents with any other model.

## 3. Persistence

- Once the user has started a task, do not stop until the specified task is
  accomplished to a level of satisfaction: completed results, validated
  artifacts, and an honest report. Work through blockers with safe in-scope
  checks and alternatives; only stop early when genuinely blocked or explicitly
  told to stop.
